discoverabilitySummary.interpretation: Static page, route, navigation, and destination evidence only. The accepted index remains FAIL / NOT_PROVEN for its enumerated open static questions; those questions are explicitly carried forward rather than reinterpreted as runtime failures.

acceptedGateReasons: 38 of 343 page audience/source purpose assignments remain unconfirmed, including legacy persona candidates and 23 public-or-unclassified candidates.
427 of 1,099 action-markup candidates have unresolved handler semantics; visible presence does not establish execution or business effect.
All 488 grouped derived-capability records remain candidates; no capability identity is verified and the remainder is explicitly unknown.
All 31 registry entries are included, but equivalence to derived actions/capabilities is not proven; owner-path classes are heuristic.
LIUNA_CONTINUITY and WORKAID_OPERATING_MODEL have no app-scoped journey step inventories in the examined sources.
176 authenticated page routes lack a direct desktop-sidebar edge; contextual links and nested discovery are not fully inventoried.
Mobile overflow, contextual CTAs, breadcrumbs, menus, and dynamic navigation are incomplete in this source census.

evidence.impact: The consumer requests /api/admin/evidence/export while the local route registry contains /api/evidence/export; the route paths do not match.

The UI requests /api/v2/analytics/scheduled-reports, absent from the local route registry. The executor writes uploaded fileUrl values but does not establish an allowed origin; retain that as a secondary unbounded-data-contract finding.
virtualMeetingUrl is nullable text consumed as a link; database text storage and the component mapping do not constrain protocol or host.
CBA source baseUrl is persisted as text and validated with z.string().url(); this proves URL syntax only, not an allowed host or origin.
Claim attachment URLs are read from attachment metadata; the case-evidence API creates blob URLs and persists attachment metadata, without a stable-origin constraint.
Editable email block content is split on a delimiter and its URL segment is used as an anchor href; the content schema is string-only and has no destination policy.
link.url is supplied by the campaign analytics response; no destination constraint is established by the consumer or response interface.
Lesson content.url is a string used as video, image, iframe, and download source; the destination host is not constrained.
Employer communication attachments expose a string url and render it directly; no producer-side destination policy was located.
Grievance and related-document consumers use fileUrl fields; the upload schema uses z.string().url() and persisted document fields are text. URL syntax/storage do not impose an allowed-host policy.

IncidentDetailView expects attachments as string[] while the generic workplaceIncidents endpoint exposes schema photoUrls as JSON string[]; no translation between these field names appears in the inspected path. The stored photo URL values also have no established origin constraint (secondary finding).
The report viewer requests /api/health-safety/inspections/{id}/report, absent from the local route registry. Its photos field is string[] with no destination policy established (secondary finding).
The scheduler requests /api/health-safety/committee/meetings, absent from the local route registry; minutesUrl is a free-form string field with no origin constraint established (secondary finding).
Knowledge-base sourceUrl is read from persisted records and exposed by the API; the text field/API read path do not establish allowed hosts or the writer contract.
Insight article Markdown is rendered with anchor links; the renderer does not establish a URL policy, and article content origin is not established by this trace.
message.fileUrl is an optional string from the thread API; its persistence writer and permitted destination set were not established.
MobileHeader accepts optional backHref with a # fallback. Inspected mobile page callers omit it; any future supplied value remains unconstrained by this prop type.
Notification actionUrl is persisted as text and returned through the notifications API; known producers include local paths and configurable values, with no shared host/protocol allowlist.
The job board requests /api/jobs, absent from the local route registry; nullable applicationUrl text has no established host constraint (secondary finding).

The page renderer requests /api/cms/pages/{pageSlug}, absent from the local route registry; raw CMS URL/buttonUrl fields have no established origin constraint (secondary finding for all three candidates).
Social feed platformUrl comes from provider permalink data persisted as text; no host allowlist is established.
Strike-fund donationPageUrl is nullable text; the located strike-fund API exposes dashboard stats, not the fund-detail writer or an origin policy.
Claim email URL combines a claim path with getAppBaseUrl(); the path is known but the configured origin is not restricted to an approved host by this trace.
Markdown content is rendered into anchors without a source-established URL allowlist; content origin and allowed protocols remain unproven.
Email actionUrl inputs are strings accepted by generic email templates; a producer-side URL policy was not established.
Notification-settings links append a fixed path to NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL; environment URL syntax validation is not an approved-origin allowlist.
DigestEmail uses persisted notification.actionUrl values; the notification field is text and permits mixed local/configurable destination producers.
Password reset URL uses getAppBaseUrl() with an encoded token and a fixed reset path; the origin is configurable and not allowlisted by URL-syntax validation.
ReportReadyEmail accepts reportUrl as a string; no producer or allowed-origin rule was established.
